The '''Ktilacs''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] that [[Homeworld/Legends|originated]] at the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ktil/Legends|Ktil]]. They ruled sixty-three [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the [[Ktilac Regions/Legends|Ktilac Regions]], an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that they co-inhabited with the [[Murachaun]] and [[Tocoyan]]s, and the three species had a common culture and quasi-religion. The Ktilacs' homeworld was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the isolationist Ktilac Regions nevertheless held the status of an [[Allied Region]] under the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].

==Society and culture==
The Ktilacs were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ktil/Legends|Ktil]], in the group of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] known as the [[Ktilac Regions/Legends|Ktilac Regions]]. Together with the [[Tocoyan]] species of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet [[Tocoya]] and<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Murachaun]] of the [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] world [[Nahsu Minor]],<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> the Ktilacs developed a common culture and quasi-religion wherein each of the three species of the Ktilac Regions was viewed as complementary to the other two. Under that belief system, the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was considered to be unholy. As such, any Ktilacs encountered outside of the Ktilac Regions were [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] apostates. Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of Ktil numbered between ten and one hundred million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Ktilacs in the galaxy==
[[File:Ktilac_Regions.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Ktilacs ruled over sixty-three star systems of the Ktilac Regions.]]
The Ktilacs, the Murachaun, and the Tocoyans each ruled sixty-three [[Star/Legends|star]] systems in the Ktilac Regions that were closed to outsiders. [[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Ktil was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> By [[17,000 BBY]], the Ktilacs' home planet had become a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], lying along [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] controlled by the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and its allies in their [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|political struggle]] against the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ktil system/Legends|Ktil system]]</ref> Ktil was situated in the territories either unaligned with or contested by the Republic and the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Sith Wars]], by which [[Time/Legends|time]] the extent of the former had been greatly reduced.<ref name="TEA" />

Ktil had once again become a member of the Republic by the time the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], however, the Ktilac homeworld had been incorporated into the territory controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the planet was a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[12 ABY/Legends|twenty-nine years]] later,<ref name="EGTW" /> with the Ktilac Regions remaining an [[Allied Region]] under both that government and its successor, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. As part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy, at some point between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of the Ktil system|attacked]] and conquered the Ktil system, but it was no longer under the control of the invaders in 27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ktilacs' name was introduced as part of a mention of the Ktilac Regions in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' first described the Ktilacs as a species.<ref name="TEA" />
